aries.title: Aries — The Spark of Beginnings
aries.body:
Aries opens the zodiac, and you may feel that sense of first light in your own nature. As a cardinal fire sign ruled by Mars, Aries tends to meet life head-on: initiating, daring and impatient with anything that feels stale. Where others wait for the perfect moment, you often create it simply by taking the first step.

Beneath the bold surface there is often a surprising innocence — a wish to stay true to yourself and to protect the people and causes you love. Your honesty can clear the air, and your enthusiasm has a way of waking others up.

- **Natural strengths:** courage, candor and a rare gift for fresh starts.
- **In relationships:** warm, direct and fiercely protective of those you choose.
- **At your best:** you turn the spark of an idea into momentum others can follow.
- **Growth edge:** patience with slower rhythms, and finishing as boldly as you begin.

Fire grows steadier when it is tended. Many people with an Aries Sun find that a pause before reacting does not dim their flame; it gives it direction. Your boldness becomes true leadership when it makes room for other voices.

Your Sun is only the first chapter: the full report reveals how your Moon, Ascendant, and month, day and hour animals blend both traditions into one portrait of who you are.

taurus.title: Taurus — The Keeper of Steady Grace
taurus.body:
Taurus is a fixed earth sign ruled by Venus, and you may recognize in yourself its blend of steadiness and sensuality. Taurus tends to trust what can be touched, tasted and built over time. You often move at your own unhurried pace, and once you commit to a person or a path, your loyalty can be remarkably enduring.

Venus lends Taurus an instinct for beauty and comfort: a well-made object, a familiar melody, a meal shared slowly. This is not mere indulgence but a way of feeling rooted in the present moment, and it often makes you a calming presence for others.

- **Natural strengths:** patience, reliability and a deep appreciation of beauty.
- **In relationships:** devoted, affectionate and steady when life feels uncertain.
- **At your best:** you build things — homes, friendships, skills — that are made to last.
- **Growth edge:** welcoming change before it feels comfortable, and loosening a firmly held view.

Earth can hold its shape for a very long time, which is both a gift and a challenge. You may find that your deepest growth begins when you let a little movement into your certainty, trusting that what is truly yours will remain.

Discover in the full report how your Moon, Ascendant, and month, day and hour animals blend both traditions around this steady Taurus heart.

gemini.title: Gemini — The Messenger of Curious Minds
gemini.body:
Gemini is a mutable air sign ruled by Mercury, the planet of language and connection. You may feel that your mind rarely sits still: ideas, questions and conversations tend to flow through you like a breeze through an open window. Gemini often thrives on variety, learning by sampling many perspectives rather than settling too soon on one.

The Twins symbolize a nature with more than one side. You may be playful and serious, sociable and private, all in the same afternoon — and that versatility can make you a gifted translator between people who do not yet understand each other.

- **Natural strengths:** curiosity, wit and a quick, adaptable intelligence.
- **In relationships:** lively, communicative and genuinely interested in other people's stories.
- **At your best:** you connect ideas and people in ways no one else had noticed.
- **Growth edge:** staying with one thread long enough to see where it leads.

Air carries everything, but it also needs a direction. Many people with a Gemini Sun find depth not by narrowing their interests, but by listening as attentively as they speak and letting a few chosen passions grow roots.

The full report shows how your Moon, Ascendant, and month, day and hour animals blend both traditions into a fuller conversation about who you are.

cancer.title: Cancer — The Guardian of the Inner Tide
cancer.body:
Cancer is a cardinal water sign ruled by the Moon, and its rhythm is the rhythm of the tides. You may feel things deeply and remember them long after others have moved on. As a cardinal sign, Cancer is not merely receptive; it often takes the initiative to create safety, belonging and a sense of home wherever it goes.

The Crab's shell is a wise image: a protective exterior around a tender, perceptive interior. You may sense the mood of a room before a word is spoken, and your care for others often shows in quiet, practical gestures rather than grand declarations.

- **Natural strengths:** empathy, intuition and a strong instinct to nurture.
- **In relationships:** loyal, attentive and deeply invested in those you hold close.
- **At your best:** you make people feel seen, safe and genuinely at home.
- **Growth edge:** voicing your own needs as freely as you meet the needs of others.

Like the Moon, your emotional landscape tends to move in phases. Honoring those cycles, rather than hiding them, can become one of your greatest strengths — the source of a resilience that is gentle but remarkably durable.

Discover in the full report how your Moon, Ascendant, and month, day and hour animals blend both traditions with this tender Cancer core.

leo.title: Leo — The Radiant Heart
leo.body:
Leo is a fixed fire sign ruled by the Sun itself, and you may carry a natural warmth that draws people in. Leo tends to live from the heart: generous, expressive and loyal, with a quiet need for its light to be recognized. As a fixed sign, that fire is not a flicker but a steady glow that others come to rely on.

There is often a creative streak here — a love of play, performance or simply making ordinary moments feel special. Your encouragement can be a real gift, helping others believe in their own brightness.

- **Natural strengths:** generosity, confidence and a big-hearted creative spirit.
- **In relationships:** affectionate, protective and wholeheartedly devoted.
- **At your best:** you lead by inspiring others rather than commanding them.
- **Growth edge:** trusting your worth even when no one is applauding.

The Sun shines without asking whether it is being watched. Many people with a Leo Sun discover that their most lasting radiance comes from that same place — a self-assurance rooted within, which leaves plenty of room for others to shine too.

The full report reveals how your Moon, Ascendant, and month, day and hour animals blend both traditions around this radiant Leo heart.

virgo.title: Virgo — The Artisan of Quiet Devotion
virgo.body:
Virgo is a mutable earth sign ruled by Mercury, combining a practical nature with a finely tuned, analytical mind. You may notice the details others overlook and feel genuine satisfaction in making things work a little better. Virgo often expresses love through service: thoughtful help, careful attention and a job done well.

As a mutable sign, Virgo is more adaptable than its reputation suggests. You may refine and adjust constantly, learning from each experience, and your modesty can hide just how much you quietly hold together for the people around you.

- **Natural strengths:** discernment, diligence and a gift for practical solutions.
- **In relationships:** attentive, dependable and caring in small, meaningful ways.
- **At your best:** you bring order and clarity where there was confusion.
- **Growth edge:** offering yourself the same patience you so readily give to others.

Perfection is a direction rather than a destination. Many people with a Virgo Sun find that their craft deepens when they allow room for imperfection, recognizing that work offered sincerely often serves life better than work polished to perfection.

Discover in the full report how your Moon, Ascendant, and month, day and hour animals blend both traditions with your discerning Virgo nature.

libra.title: Libra — The Art of Harmony
libra.body:
Libra is a cardinal air sign ruled by Venus, uniting a love of beauty with a keen sense of fairness. You may feel most at ease when there is balance — between people, between ideas and among the many sides of a question. As a cardinal sign, Libra does not simply wait for harmony; it often takes the initiative to create it.

The Scales are the only inanimate symbol of the zodiac, a reminder that Libra tends to weigh things thoughtfully. Your gift for seeing every perspective can make you a natural mediator, and your grace often softens even difficult conversations.

- **Natural strengths:** diplomacy, refined taste and a strong sense of justice.
- **In relationships:** considerate, charming and devoted to genuine partnership.
- **At your best:** you build bridges and bring out the best in others.
- **Growth edge:** choosing before every option has been weighed, and voicing honest disagreement.

True balance is not the absence of tension but the art of holding it well. Many people with a Libra Sun discover that their own voice, clearly spoken, is part of the harmony they seek rather than a threat to it.

The full report shows how your Moon, Ascendant, and month, day and hour animals blend both traditions into a fuller picture of your balance.

scorpio.title: Scorpio — The Depths That Transform
scorpio.body:
Scorpio is a fixed water sign, traditionally ruled by Mars and, in modern astrology, by Pluto. You may experience feelings with unusual intensity and prefer depth to surface. Scorpio tends to see beneath appearances, sensing motives and undercurrents, and once committed — to a person, a purpose or a truth — it rarely does things by halves.

Water that is fixed runs deep and still. You may guard your inner world carefully, sharing it only where trust has been earned, yet those who reach it often find extraordinary loyalty, insight and resilience.

- **Natural strengths:** emotional depth, focus and a perceptive, investigative mind.
- **In relationships:** intensely loyal, private and fully present when trust is real.
- **At your best:** you help others face what is hidden and emerge renewed.
- **Growth edge:** letting go of what has run its course, and trusting without needing control.

Scorpio is often linked with transformation — the ability to let something end so that something truer can begin. Your power tends to grow most when it is used to illuminate and restore rather than to guard old wounds.

Discover in the full report how your Moon, Ascendant, and month, day and hour animals blend both traditions with this deep Scorpio current.

sagittarius.title: Sagittarius — The Archer of Far Horizons
sagittarius.body:
Sagittarius is a mutable fire sign ruled by Jupiter, the planet of growth and wisdom. You may feel a restless longing for meaning, whether you seek it through travel, study, faith or simply a good conversation that stretches the mind. Sagittarius tends to aim its arrow at the horizon, trusting that the journey will teach as much as the arrival.

Your optimism can be contagious, and your honesty, though occasionally blunt, usually comes from a sincere wish for truth. As a mutable sign, you often adapt easily to new places and people, finding kinship across very different worlds.

- **Natural strengths:** enthusiasm, generosity of spirit and a philosophical outlook.
- **In relationships:** open-hearted, adventurous and refreshingly honest.
- **At your best:** you widen other people's horizons and remind them that life is larger than their worries.
- **Growth edge:** following through on commitments, and tempering candor with tact.

Freedom is precious to you, yet the deepest adventures may be found by staying long enough to go beneath the surface. Many Sagittarians discover that wisdom grows not only from distance traveled but from depth explored.

The full report reveals how your Moon, Ascendant, and month, day and hour animals blend both traditions along your own path.

capricorn.title: Capricorn — The Patient Summit
capricorn.body:
Capricorn is a cardinal earth sign ruled by Saturn, the planet of structure, time and mastery. You may carry a quiet seriousness and a sense of responsibility that appeared early in life. As a cardinal sign, Capricorn takes initiative in practical ways, setting goals and climbing toward them steadily, one sure-footed step at a time.

The Sea-Goat — part mountain climber, part creature of the deep — hints at a richer inner life than Capricorn usually shows. Beneath your reserve there may be a dry wit, deep loyalty and feelings you prefer to express through actions rather than words.

- **Natural strengths:** discipline, perseverance and sound practical judgment.
- **In relationships:** dependable, committed and quietly devoted over the long term.
- **At your best:** you build lasting foundations that others can stand on.
- **Growth edge:** resting without guilt, and letting yourself be supported too.

Saturn teaches that time is an ally. Many people with a Capricorn Sun find that life grows lighter as the years pass, as they learn that their worth is measured not only by what they achieve but by who they are along the way.

Discover in the full report how your Moon, Ascendant, and month, day and hour animals blend both traditions on your climb.

aquarius.title: Aquarius — The Visionary of Tomorrow
aquarius.body:
Aquarius is a fixed air sign, traditionally ruled by Saturn and, in modern astrology, by Uranus. You may combine an independent, inventive mind with a steady commitment to your principles. Aquarius tends to think in terms of the bigger picture — communities, ideas and futures — and often sees possibilities long before others are ready for them.

Despite its name, Aquarius is an air sign: the Water-Bearer pours out knowledge and ideas for everyone to share. You may value friendship deeply, treat people as equals and feel most alive when contributing to something larger than yourself.

- **Natural strengths:** originality, open-mindedness and a humanitarian spirit.
- **In relationships:** a loyal, unconventional friend who respects each person's freedom.
- **At your best:** you imagine a better way and invite others to build it with you.
- **Growth edge:** letting feelings speak alongside ideas, and staying open to views that challenge yours.

Being fixed, your air can hold firm convictions. Many Aquarians find that their vision becomes most powerful when paired with warmth — when the future they imagine includes room for the tender, personal connections of the present.

The full report shows how your Moon, Ascendant, and month, day and hour animals blend both traditions into your own singular vision.

pisces.title: Pisces — The Ocean of Dreams
pisces.body:
Pisces is a mutable water sign, traditionally ruled by Jupiter and, in modern astrology, by Neptune. You may feel porous to the world around you, absorbing moods, music and atmospheres with unusual sensitivity. As the final sign of the zodiac, Pisces is often linked with compassion and imagination — a sense that everything is quietly connected.

The two Fish swimming in opposite directions suggest a nature that moves between the practical and the poetic. You may find inspiration in art, spirituality or nature, and your gentleness often makes others feel understood without needing to explain themselves.

- **Natural strengths:** compassion, imagination and deep intuitive insight.
- **In relationships:** tender, accepting and generous with your time and heart.
- **At your best:** you bring beauty, kindness and meaning into ordinary days.
- **Growth edge:** setting gentle boundaries, and honoring your own needs as well as those of others.

Water takes the shape of whatever holds it, so the spaces you choose matter. Many people with a Pisces Sun flourish when they give their sensitivity a form — a creative practice, a sanctuary, a calling — through which it can flow freely.

Discover in the full report how your Moon, Ascendant, and month, day and hour animals blend both traditions within your Pisces depths.

rat.title: Rat — The Clever Pathfinder
rat.body:
The Rat opens the cycle of the Chinese zodiac, and legend says it won its place through wit rather than strength, riding on the Ox's back and leaping ahead at the finish. Its fixed element is water and its polarity yang, giving Rat natives a quick, flowing intelligence that tends to find a way around any obstacle.

You may be observant, resourceful and attuned to opportunities others miss. Beneath a sociable, charming surface there is often a careful planner who likes to be prepared, and a loyal friend who remembers the people who stood by them.

- **Natural strengths:** quick thinking, adaptability and a sharp eye for detail.
- **In relationships:** charming, attentive and devoted to a trusted inner circle.
- **At your best:** you turn limited resources into clever, practical solutions.
- **Growth edge:** easing restless worry, and trusting that not every outcome needs a plan.

Water moves most gracefully when it is not forced. Many people born in a Rat year find that their brilliance deepens when they balance vigilance with generosity, sharing what they know and allowing life to surprise them. The element of your particular birth year adds its own color to this portrait.

Your year animal is the first of four pillars: the full report explores how your month, day and hour animals, together with your Moon and Ascendant, blend both traditions into one coherent picture.

ox.title: Ox — The Steady Cultivator
ox.body:
The Ox carries the fixed element of earth with yin polarity, and its nature is as grounded as the fields it was once trusted to plow. In Chinese tradition, the Ox symbolizes diligence, patience and honest effort. You may prefer to prove yourself through steady work rather than words, earning respect slowly and keeping it for a long time.

There is often a deep reliability here: when an Ox commits, people tend to know they can count on them. Behind a calm, sometimes reserved exterior, you may hold strong convictions and a quiet tenderness kept for those closest to you.

- **Natural strengths:** perseverance, dependability and a calm, methodical mind.
- **In relationships:** faithful, protective and sincere rather than showy.
- **At your best:** you see a long project through when others have given up.
- **Growth edge:** bending when circumstances change, and sharing your feelings before they build up.

Earth gives everything time to grow. Many people born in an Ox year find that life becomes richer when they allow themselves moments of play and rest, and when they trust others to share the load they so willingly carry. The element of your birth year adds its own nuance to this foundation.

Your year animal is the first of four pillars: the full report explores how your month, day and hour animals, along with your Moon and Ascendant, blend both traditions around this patient strength.

tiger.title: Tiger — The Spirit of Courage
tiger.body:
The Tiger is a yang animal whose fixed element is wood, the element of growth, vision and upward movement. In Chinese tradition it is a guardian figure, admired for bravery and natural authority. You may carry a magnetic confidence and a strong sense of justice, often stepping forward when something needs defending.

Tiger natives tend to live vividly, following their passions with energy and a love of independence. You may chafe at rules that feel pointless, and your enthusiasm can inspire others to be braver than they thought they could be.

- **Natural strengths:** courage, charisma and a generous, protective spirit.
- **In relationships:** passionate, sincere and loyal to the people you champion.
- **At your best:** you lead with conviction and lift others with your daring.
- **Growth edge:** pausing before leaping, and channeling restless energy into lasting aims.

Wood grows strongest when it has deep roots. Many people born in a Tiger year find that their boldness gains wisdom when paired with patience, allowing their courage to build something that endures. The element of your specific birth year adds further color to this portrait.

Your year animal is only one of four pillars — the full report explores how your month, day and hour animals, together with your Moon and Ascendant, blend both traditions with your fearless spirit.

rabbit.title: Rabbit — The Moonlit Diplomat
rabbit.body:
The Rabbit is a yin animal whose fixed element is wood, lending it a gentle, growing quality like spring leaves unfolding. In Chinese tradition the Rabbit is linked with the Moon, elegance and refinement. You may have a natural diplomacy, a love of beauty and a gift for creating calm, harmonious spaces around you.

Rabbit natives tend to be perceptive and tactful, reading people with quiet sensitivity. You may prefer to resolve tension with grace rather than confrontation, and your kindness often makes others feel safe and appreciated.

- **Natural strengths:** tact, refined taste and a thoughtful, intuitive mind.
- **In relationships:** gentle, considerate and devoted to peace and comfort.
- **At your best:** you soothe tensions and bring elegance to everyday life.
- **Growth edge:** speaking up when something matters, even if it disturbs the calm.

Wood bends without breaking. Many people born in a Rabbit year discover that their softness is a form of strength, and that a little courage in moments of conflict protects the harmony they value so deeply. The element of your particular birth year adds its own nuance to this portrait.

Your year animal is the first of four pillars: the full report explores how your month, day and hour animals, along with your Moon and Ascendant, blend both traditions with this graceful nature.

dragon.title: Dragon — The Sovereign of Vision
dragon.body:
The Dragon is the only mythical creature in the Chinese zodiac, long revered as a symbol of power, vitality and imperial dignity. Its fixed element is earth and its polarity yang, grounding a grand imagination in real ambition. You may carry a commanding presence and a sense that life is meant to be lived on a large scale.

Dragon natives tend to be energetic, confident and generous with their enthusiasm. You may set high standards for yourself and others, and your vision can inspire people to reach further than they imagined possible.

- **Natural strengths:** charisma, ambition and abundant creative energy.
- **In relationships:** passionate, generous and protective of those you love.
- **At your best:** you dream boldly and rally others around a shared purpose.
- **Growth edge:** listening as fully as you lead, and accepting that not every plan needs to be grand.

Earth gives the Dragon's soaring vision a place to land. Many people born in a Dragon year find that their finest achievements come when vision is matched by humility and patience, leaving room for others on the stage. The element of your birth year adds its own shade to this portrait.

Your year animal is the first of four pillars: the full report explores how your month, day and hour animals, together with your Moon and Ascendant, blend both traditions into one living portrait.

snake.title: Snake — The Quiet Sage
snake.body:
The Snake is a yin animal whose fixed element is fire — not a blazing fire, but a steady, inward glow. In Chinese tradition it is associated with wisdom, intuition and elegance. You may think deeply before speaking, notice more than you reveal and trust your instincts about people and situations.

Snake natives often possess a composed, graceful presence and a refined sense of style. You may prefer meaningful conversation to small talk, and when you set your sights on a goal, you tend to pursue it with calm, strategic patience.

- **Natural strengths:** insight, discernment and a calm, strategic mind.
- **In relationships:** devoted, perceptive and deeply loyal once trust is earned.
- **At your best:** you see what others miss and offer wise, measured counsel.
- **Growth edge:** sharing your inner world more freely, and releasing lingering suspicion.

The Snake sheds its skin in order to grow, a beautiful image of renewal. Many people born in a Snake year find that their wisdom deepens each time they let go of an old certainty and allow themselves to be truly known. The element of your particular birth year adds its own color to this portrait.

Your year animal is only one of four pillars — the full report explores how your month, day and hour animals, along with your Moon and Ascendant, blend both traditions with this quiet wisdom.

horse.title: Horse — The Free Spirit in Motion
horse.body:
The Horse is a yang animal whose fixed element is fire, and its nature is full of warmth, movement and vitality. In Chinese tradition the Horse symbolizes freedom, endurance and an unbridled love of life. You may feel happiest when you have room to roam, whether across new landscapes, new ideas or new friendships.

Horse natives tend to be sociable, cheerful and quick to act, bringing energy to any gathering. You may speak your mind openly and inspire others with your enthusiasm, though you rarely enjoy being held back or closely supervised.

- **Natural strengths:** energy, independence and a warm, expressive spirit.
- **In relationships:** lively, generous and honest, needing trust and a little space.
- **At your best:** you set things in motion and carry others along with your zest.
- **Growth edge:** pacing yourself, and seeing commitments through after the first excitement fades.

A horse runs farthest when it finds its rhythm. Many people born in a Horse year discover that freedom grows richer when it includes a few deep commitments, giving their energy a place to return to. The element of your birth year adds its own nuance to this portrait.

Your year animal is the first of four pillars: the full report explores how your month, day and hour animals, together with your Moon and Ascendant, blend both traditions along your journey.

goat.title: Goat — The Gentle Artist
goat.body:
The Goat, sometimes called the Sheep, is a yin animal whose fixed element is earth. In Chinese tradition it is associated with gentleness, creativity and peace. You may have a soft-spoken grace and a rich imagination, finding beauty in nature, in art and in the simple comforts that make a home feel like a sanctuary.

Goat natives tend to be compassionate and attuned to the feelings of others. You may prefer cooperation to competition, and your kindness often creates a sense of ease wherever you are. Your creativity can flourish beautifully when you feel supported and secure.

- **Natural strengths:** empathy, artistic sensitivity and a calm, gracious manner.
- **In relationships:** caring, devoted and generous with gentle attention.
- **At your best:** you bring harmony, beauty and comfort to the people around you.
- **Growth edge:** trusting your own judgment, and deciding without waiting for complete certainty.

Earth offers the Goat steady ground for its dreams. Many people born in a Goat year find that their gifts blossom when they believe in their own voice, recognizing that gentleness and quiet strength often go hand in hand. The element of your birth year adds its own shade to this portrait.

Your year animal is the first of four pillars: the full report explores how your month, day and hour animals, along with your Moon and Ascendant, blend both traditions with this gentle spirit.

monkey.title: Monkey — The Brilliant Improviser
monkey.body:
The Monkey is a yang animal whose fixed element is metal, lending its playful intelligence a sharp, precise edge. In Chinese tradition the Monkey is celebrated for cleverness, curiosity and ingenuity — think of the legendary Monkey King. You may love solving puzzles, learning new skills and finding inventive ways around obstacles.

Monkey natives tend to be witty, sociable and full of ideas, often bringing humor and energy into every room. You may adapt quickly to new situations and enjoy keeping life interesting, sometimes juggling several projects at once.

- **Natural strengths:** ingenuity, versatility and a quick, playful wit.
- **In relationships:** entertaining, warm and endlessly interesting company.
- **At your best:** you find creative solutions where others see only problems.
- **Growth edge:** focusing your talents on fewer goals, and staying patient once the novelty wears off.

Metal sharpens with care. Many people born in a Monkey year find that their brilliance becomes most powerful when paired with consistency and sincerity, turning cleverness into lasting achievement and trust. The element of your particular birth year adds its own color to this portrait.

Your year animal is only one of four pillars — the full report explores how your month, day and hour animals, together with your Moon and Ascendant, blend both traditions in your inventive mind.

rooster.title: Rooster — The Herald of the Dawn
rooster.body:
The Rooster is a yin animal whose fixed element is metal, giving it clarity, precision and a strong sense of order. In Chinese tradition it heralds the dawn, a symbol of punctuality, honesty and courage. You may be observant, hardworking and confident in your judgments, with a keen eye for what could be done better.

Rooster natives tend to take pride in their appearance and their work, bringing care and polish to everything they touch. You may speak frankly and hold high standards, and your dedication often makes you a trusted pillar for those around you.

- **Natural strengths:** diligence, honesty and an organized, precise mind.
- **In relationships:** loyal, straightforward and devoted in practical ways.
- **At your best:** you bring clarity and structure that help others thrive.
- **Growth edge:** softening criticism with warmth, and allowing yourself to be imperfect.

Metal shines when it is polished, yet it also reflects light back to others. Many people born in a Rooster year find that their gifts grow richer when they notice and praise the qualities of others as readily as they spot flaws. The element of your birth year adds its own nuance to this portrait.

Your year animal is the first of four pillars: the full report explores how your month, day and hour animals, along with your Moon and Ascendant, blend both traditions with your clear-eyed nature.

dog.title: Dog — The Loyal Guardian
dog.body:
The Dog is a yang animal whose fixed element is earth, giving it a grounded, trustworthy character. In Chinese tradition the Dog symbolizes loyalty, honesty and a strong sense of justice. You may be the friend others turn to in difficult moments, valued for your sincerity and your readiness to stand up for what is right.

Dog natives tend to be protective of the people and principles they care about. You may be cautious with newcomers but deeply devoted once trust is established, and your fairness often makes you a natural voice for those who are overlooked.

- **Natural strengths:** loyalty, integrity and a dependable sense of fairness.
- **In relationships:** faithful, supportive and sincere to the core.
- **At your best:** you defend what matters and create circles of trust around you.
- **Growth edge:** releasing worry about what might go wrong, and trusting more easily.

Earth gives the Dog a steady place to stand. Many people born in a Dog year find that their idealism becomes a gift rather than a burden when they balance high principles with forgiveness — for others and for themselves. The element of your birth year adds its own shade to this portrait.

Your year animal is only one of four pillars — the full report explores how your month, day and hour animals, together with your Moon and Ascendant, blend both traditions with your faithful heart.

pig.title: Pig — The Generous Soul
pig.body:
The Pig closes the twelve-animal cycle, and it is a yin animal whose fixed element is water. In Chinese tradition the Pig is associated with abundance, sincerity and good-hearted generosity. You may have a warm, easygoing nature and a genuine enjoyment of life's pleasures: good food, good company and honest conversation.

Pig natives tend to be kind, tolerant and quick to see the best in others. You may be a gracious host and a faithful friend, and your sincerity often helps people relax and feel accepted just as they are.

- **Natural strengths:** generosity, sincerity and a warm, forgiving heart.
- **In relationships:** affectionate, loyal and devoted to shared happiness.
- **At your best:** you create welcoming spaces where people feel truly at ease.
- **Growth edge:** setting clear boundaries, and trusting your instincts about who has earned your trust.

Water nourishes everything it touches. Many people born in a Pig year find that their kindness flourishes when it is balanced with discernment, protecting the open heart that is their greatest gift. The element of your particular birth year adds its own color to this portrait.

Your year animal is the first of four pillars: the full report explores how your month, day and hour animals, along with your Moon and Ascendant, blend both traditions with this generous spirit.
